method.core_profit: Profit before tax - exceptional items - other income
method.financials: Profit after tax; sales = net interest income (banks, lending NBFCs), net premium (insurers), else total income
method.ranking: base profit <= 0: sales growth; 0 < base < Rs 5 Cr: lower of profit and sales growth; else profit growth; capped at +300% for scoring
method.bse_only: BSE-only companies from their Screener pages (BSE's data service refuses scripts); Screener's other income includes exceptional items
method.sme: SME companies mostly report half-yearly: compared with the same half a year earlier, no quarter-on-quarter figure
